method: Inspect paired screenshots and replay actual generated controls; color alone does not count as structural improvement.

topics.name: academic
observations: Old standard uses a compact identity/contact strip followed by dense continuous biography and research sections.
New standard adds a separate top navigation and larger identity area, then emphasizes numbered research steps; both remain warm light single-column pages.
New deep uses Chinese serif headings and a research proposition as the main heading, with a narrow reading column and timeline-like research stages.
The changes are visible but this pair alone does not demonstrate a stronger, distinctive academic information architecture.
verifiedInteractions: new-standard: copy email and toggle publications
new-deep: copy email and toggle earlier publications
topics.limitations: Clipboard adapter was observed in an isolated browser replay; no personal clipboard was read or written.
